record.paper_title: Open problems on graphs arising from geometric topology
record.original_question: For a Heegaard genus two 3-manifold represented by a colored graph arising from a 6-tuple of integers (n_1, h_1; n_2, h_2; n_3, h_3), write a finite presentation of its fundamental group directly in terms of that 6-tuple.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background. A crystallisation of a closed connected 3-manifold $M$ is a 4-edge-coloured graph $(\Gamma,\gamma)$ with $\gamma:E(\Gamma)\to\{0,1,2,3\}$ such that edges of each colour form a perfect matching, $\Gamma$ is regular of degree 4, and the dual ball complex of $(\Gamma,\gamma)$ is a pseudo-triangulation of $M$ with exactly one vertex of each colour. Casali and Grasselli showed that every closed orientable 3-manifold of Heegaard genus at most two can be encoded by a 6-tuple of nonnegative integers
$$(n_1,h_1;\,n_2,h_2;\,n_3,h_3)$$
that determines a crystallisation $\Gamma(n_1,h_1;n_2,h_2;n_3,h_3)$ of the manifold together with a genus-two Heegaard splitting; the integers $n_i$ control the lengths of the three "arc systems" of the crystallisation and the integers $h_i$ are shift parameters.

Problem. Produce an explicit finite presentation
$$\pi_1\bigl(M(n_1,h_1;n_2,h_2;n_3,h_3)\bigr)=\langle\,x,y\mid R_1(n_1,h_1;n_2,h_2;n_3,h_3),\,R_2(n_1,h_1;n_2,h_2;n_3,h_3)\,\rangle$$
of the fundamental group of the closed 3-manifold $M(n_1,h_1;n_2,h_2;n_3,h_3)$ associated to such an admissible 6-tuple, in which the generators and the relators are written as explicit words determined directly by the six integers $n_1,h_1,n_2,h_2,n_3,h_3$ (without invoking an algorithm applied to the crystallisation in each individual case).
artifact.status_search_result: Searches reveal that genus-two 3-manifolds encoded by admissible 6-tuples have been catalogued and their fundamental group presentations computed case-by-case via Gagliardi's algorithm applied to the crystallisation, but no closed-form 2-generator 2-relator presentation expressed uniformly in terms of the six parameters appears to be available. The problem's status as of the latest accessible literature is not clearly resolved.

status_evidence.title: Three-manifolds with Heegaard genus at most two represented by crystallisations with at most 42 vertices
status_evidence.snippet: Catalogues of admissible 6-tuples and relators of fundamental groups given by the respective 6-tuples are derived, computed via Gagliardi's algorithm on each crystallisation.
status_evidence.claim: Presentations are produced case-by-case from the crystallisation rather than as a uniform formula in the 6-tuple.

status_evidence.title: Graphs encoding 3-manifolds of genus 2
status_evidence.snippet: Every 3-manifold of Heegaard genus two is encoded by an admissible 6-tuple of integers that also determines a genus two Heegaard splitting.
status_evidence.claim: Confirms the 6-tuple encoding setup used in the problem.
